patterns.description: {label_name} codes naming recurring behavioral processes. Each pattern is evidenced by multiple segments.

definition.description: 2-3 sentences defining what this pattern captures: what behavior recurs, under what conditions, with what variation.

segment_refs.description: 1-based indices of segments that evidence this pattern.

confidence.description: How strongly the segments converge on this pattern.

incidents.description: Syntheses of a single behavioral process. Each incident fuses the segments that describe the same behavioral process into one coherent statement. NOT codes, NOT a copy of a segment, NOT a bare list of separate facts.

description.description: Synthesized statement of ONE behavioral process described by the cited segments, never one per segment. Plain language, {label_anti}. Example: 'the teacher arrived at 5am, found no materials and paid for them out of pocket'.

segment_refs.description: 1-based indices of ALL the segments that compose this incident (the segments describing the same behavioral process).

patterns.description: 0-based indices of patterns that this incident supports. Optional.

exact_quote.description: Verbatim quote from any of the cited segments that best supports this synthesis. Optional.

core_pattern.description: What core {object_of_study} pattern drives this participant's behavior? 2-3 sentences.

core_pattern_confidence.description: Confidence in the core {object_of_study} pattern assessment.

tentative_concern.description: What is this participant continuously trying to resolve? A {label_name} phrase.

anomalies.description: Segments or patterns that don't fit or require verification. Optional.

needs_verification.description: true if this document contains patterns that should be flagged for verification.
